description:
Code, frozen results, reproducibility data, and independent verification artifacts for subject-independent recognition of lower-limb activities from surface EMG and inertial signals of the public SDALLE dataset.

Version 2.0.0 adds the rate-matching study: a comparison of rate-matched surface EMG (cubic interpolation to the inertial sampling rate, no anti-aliasing filter) with native-rate surface EMG inside one dual-branch convolutional network of fixed size (330,052 parameters; 9 leave-one-participant-out folds × 5 random seeds = 90 runs). The primary comparison is a protocol-specified primary analysis (not fully prespecified), as execution details (exact signed-rank null distribution, percentile bootstrap interval, seed averaging, and reference significance level of 0.05) were fixed in the analysis script rather than in the protocol text itself.

The Three Zenodo Release Archives:

This Zenodo deposition contains exactly three prepared frozen archives (no additional repository ZIP is uploaded to Zenodo):

  • 1. Primary archive (v2_release_candidate_final.zip, 305 files, 1.95 MB): internal protocol, training and analysis code, per-window predictions (all 90 runs), run records, training histories, canonical result tables and figures.
  • 2. Reproducibility archive (v2_reproducibility_data_final.zip, 18 files, 2.38 GB): 18 preprocessed input arrays (9 folds × 2 conditions) enabling direct retraining and array-level auditing without re-downloading raw SDALLE files.
  • 3. Verification archive (v2_verification_audit.zip, 23 files, 68 kB): independent verification scripts, recomputed statistical outputs, spectral analysis of all 361 raw trials, array content digests, and scientific discrepancy register.

The companion version-controlled GitHub tree (including additional preprocessing source modules that rebuild the input arrays bit-identically from raw SDALLE files) is maintained at https://github.com/SaqibAhmadBhat/subject-independent-emg-imu-fusion/tree/v2.0.0.

Distinction of Verification Artifacts:

  • Statistical verification from frozen predictions: statistical_verification_output.json, sensitivity_analysis_output.json, additional_statistics_output.json, and audit_90_runs_output.json recompute every reported metric, Wilcoxon signed-rank test (W = 5, p = 0.039), bootstrap confidence interval, and sensitivity analysis strictly from the frozen predictions.csv and run records, without requiring raw signal files or GPU hardware.
  • Spectral analysis from original 361 raw trials: emg_spectrum_check_all_trials.json (generated by emg_spectrum_check.py) calculates Welch power spectral density, median frequency, and power above 74 Hz directly from the raw sEMG signals across all 361 recording trials of the 9 SDALLE participants, establishing the presence of high-frequency signal content that is aliased during unfiltered cubic resampling.
  • Array integrity and regeneration digests: processed_array_content_digests.json, audit_processed_arrays_output.json, and regeneration_check_output.json verify data normalization, train/test separation, and bit-identical array regeneration.

Model Checkpoints and Reproducibility Tiers:

Frozen model checkpoint weights (.pt, ~117 MB total) are not included in any public release component; they are preserved offline and available from the authors upon request. We distinguish three levels of reproduction:

  1. Stored prediction reproducibility (Level 1): exact recomputation of all reported metrics, bootstrap confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests from frozen per-window predictions using the released verification scripts without PyTorch or GPU hardware.
  2. Retraining reproducibility (Level 3): end-to-end retraining from preprocessed arrays reproducing findings within expected seed/fold variation.
  3. Exact checkpoint reproduction: bit-identical weight replication is subject to platform- and library-dependent floating-point non-determinism across disparate hardware architectures.

Statistical Limitations (Manuscript v2.1):

Findings are suggestive, not firm. The study has small sample size (N = 9 male participants, power 80% only for large effect sizes dz ≥ 1.07); significance is sensitive to individual participants (omitting any one of 8 RM-favouring participants yields p = 0.055–0.078), seed aggregation (median over seeds gives p = 0.055), and individual seeds (only 2 of 5 seeds alone have p < 0.05). Conditions differ in input length and receptive-field duration (189 ms vs 22.2 ms), and resampling was unfiltered, so the design does not isolate an underlying mechanism. Cross-validation folds share 7 of 8 training participants, making p-values and confidence intervals approximate.

Version 1.0.0 (tag v1.0.0, multirate fusion study) is unchanged and remains at the repository root and under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22649505. All versions are linked under Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22649504.

The raw SDALLE dataset is not redistributed; obtain it from https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14841611 (CC BY 4.0).
